verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Snyk requires an API token/authentication for CLI and MCP server use (snyk auth, 401 errors), but there is no documentation of scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific credential issuance (e.g., service accounts with restricted permissions, per-agent tokens). Missing for 10: any mention of API token scopes/roles, service-account creation for agents, or least-privilege credential management for AI agents.
